provenance: G16g native six-actor 48-output per-model study; this instrument affects blinded presentation and human evaluation only; model generation protocol remains unchanged

categories.voice_distinctiveness: How recognisably different this speaker's voice is from other voice groups, given all their samples
categories.profile_fidelity: How well the speech matches the neutral reference traits without forcing a stereotyped tone
categories.grounding: Faithfulness to stated context and preselected intent; no invented factual or authority claims
categories.naturalness: Appropriate cadence, clarity and plausibly spoken conversational language
categories.emotional_fit: Response's emotional register fits the relationship, uncertainty and scene
